newsitem.title: UK: Halifax to offer shareholder account.
newsitem.headline: Halifax to offer shareholder account.

text.p: The Halifax Building Society said on Tuesday it will launch a Halifax Shareholder Account to enable its present members to hold, buy and sell shares electronically without the need for share certificates.
Currently mutually owned, the Halifax will float on the stock exchange in June and become a public limited company with bank status.

It said the new account will be free of charges for at least three years, will provide regular statements of the account position and will initially give exclusive access to the new Halifax Share dealing Service to be launched in June.
The dealing service will initially only deal in Halifax shares but Shareholder Account customers will later be offered facilities to deal in other shares as well.
The Halifax flotation is still subject to approval by the Building Societies Commission and other regulatory approvals.
